help.title: Application help
help.content:
1. Select the source folder that contains the files to be copied.
2. Connect one or more USB drives and use the refresh button to detect available devices.
3. Choose the copy mode:
   - "Copy to folder" – the application creates a target folder on each USB drive using the name of the selected source folder and preserves the subfolder structure,
   - "Copy only files to drive root" – files are copied directly to the root of the USB drive.
4. In drive root mode, you can use the "Select files" button to choose only specific files for copying. If you do not select any files manually, the application copies all available files.
5. Click "Start copy" to begin copying in parallel to all detected USB drives.
6. Copy progress is shown separately for each USB drive and also globally in the overall status panel.
7. You can stop the operation at any time by clicking "Stop copy".

Notes:
- The target folder name is set automatically from the selected source folder name when folder mode is enabled.
- In drive root mode, no additional destination folder is created.
- The application requires a valid source folder, at least one detected USB drive, and available files for copying.
